scheme_name: Women’s Instinct for Developing and Ushering in Scientific Heights & Innovation
other_conditions: Permanent employee women scientists retiring within a year or already retired/superannuated from government academic/research institutions
Ph.D. in Basic/Applied Sciences or equivalent degree
Minimum 2 R&D projects as Principal Investigator with excellent track record
Minimum 20 research publications with impact factor
benefits_summary: Provides PI fellowship of ₹75,000 per month, one research assistant, annual research grant of ₹5  lakh, and institutional overhead of ₹1  lakh per year.
